title: cyperus esculentus proles aureus
intro: Cyperus esculentus proles aureus, commonly known as yellow nutsedge, is a type of perennial sedge that belongs to the Cyperaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of yellow nutsedge include antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of yellow nutsedge include flavonoids, saponins, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
